theme.primary_archetype: Archetype 2: The Performance Pro (Elite Athleticism & Precision)
theme.mode: Both (Dark Mode Default with Light Toggle)
theme.design_philosophy: Command-center focus. High-visibility 'Tactical Minimal' look. Sharp edges, 1px solid borders. No soft shadows. Data is king.

headings.usage: H1-H3, metric numbers, and high-impact labels. Must use uppercase and tracking-tight.

display.usage: Massive stats on the dashboard, hero headlines. Never use for body.

body.usage: All paragraph text, inputs, datatables, and secondary labels.

layout_and_spacing.structure: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 or gap-6
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use tight gaps for dashboard widgets (gap-4). Generous padding inside cards (p-6) to avoid collision.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. Use border-collapse patterns or 1px solid borders on cards. border-r border-b. Remove last item border if needed.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-none or max rounded-sm. Absolutely no pill-shapes or large rounded corners. Keep it sharp and tactical.
layout_and_spacing.shadows: Replace soft shadows with 1px solid strokes or 2px 'Inner Glow' highlights (box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1)).

buttons.primary: bg-[#CCFF00] text-[#0A0A0A] hover:bg-[#B3E600] rounded-none font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#CCFF00] text-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#CCFF00]/10 rounded-none font-bold uppercase tracking-wider

cards.header: Flex row, justify-between, uppercase overline label, border-b border-border pb-4 mb-4

inputs_and_forms.style: bg-background border border-border rounded-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#CCFF00] focus:border-[#CCFF00] text-text_primary px-4 py-2
inputs_and_forms.labels: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-text_secondary mb-2 block font-['Barlow_Condensed']

charts.style: Tactical neon lines (Volt Yellow / Electric Blaze). High-contrast dots. NO area fills unless 10% opacity. Dotted grid lines at 10% opacity. Tooltips must be sharp-edged black boxes with 1px Volt Yellow border.

navigation.style: Sticky top bar or sleek side rail. Glassmorphism ONLY if heavily blurred (backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/80) with 1px bottom border. Otherwise solid surface color.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Crisp color inversions or subtle border brightness increases. E.g., border-white/10 becomes border-[#CCFF00].
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Fast, mechanical ease-outs. No slow fades. Use framer-motion for staggering dashboard widgets on load (stagger children by 0.05s).
motion_and_interaction.active_states: Elements should physically depress (scale: 0.98) to feel tactile.

media_and_assets.rules: Never use placeholders. Use provided URLs. Overlay hero images with bg-black/60 to ensure text readability.

hero_background.description: Macro shot of dark obsidian metallic gym textures with volt yellow edge lighting. Use for main landing page hero or authentication page background.

dashboard_data_bg.description: 3D topographic lines with neon highlight. Perfect for empty states or the background of the calorie macro calculator section.

workout_feature_1.description: Man doing dip exercise. Use for workout integration section.

workout_feature_2.description: Muscular man doing lat pulldown. Use for progress tracking visual.

meal_prep_feature.description: Colorful healthy meal prep. Use for food logger / nutrition section.

meal_prep_secondary.description: Containers of prepared meals. Use for meal history.

icons.style: Use strokeWidth={1.5} for a sharp, technical look. Do not use filled icons.

testing.attributes: ALL interactive elements MUST include data-testid. e.g. data-testid="calorie-log-button", data-testid="theme-toggle".

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'Tactical Minimalism' aesthetic. The UI should look like a command center for an athlete.
Do not use generic border radii. Stick to rounded-none or rounded-sm for a sharp edge.
For the theme toggle, use the provided dark and light color systems. Dark mode should be the default.
Use Shadcn UI components but strip away their default Vercel-like soft radii and borders. Make them flat and sharp.
Integrate the Bebas Neue and Barlow Condensed fonts for headings and Manrope for body text. Use Google Fonts via index.css.
Ensure all text layered over images has a strong backdrop (bg-black/60 or gradient) to maintain contrast.
Construct the dashboard using the 'Control Room' grid philosophy (dense, highly utilized space).
